title: After Dark Jacquard Polo
body_html:
Black on black. Always.

This one is for when you want something premium yet understated. Black on black detailing in every aspect, the fabric, prints and embroidery.

Our signature boxy fit sits right without needing to be tucked. Performance fabric keeps it breathable and non-stick through long rounds, range sessions, or whatever happens after.

THE FIT
- Unisex, boxy fit
- Tonal Jacquard Stripe

THE FABRIC
- Mid-weight, Nylon Elastane Blend
- Custom black Jacquard stripe
- Chest: raised-textured print
- Rear: raised-textured print

- Sleeves: Embroidery

THE DETAILS
- Premium Midiron branded trims
- "Member" bag tag included

FIT & SIZING
Josh is 5'5" and wearing a size S, Corey is 5'10, 75kg and wearing a size L.
True to size.

If unsure of your size email us at contact@midiron.com.au and we will happily help.

title: Tour Spec Pleated Short
body_html:
Golf shorts, without looking like golf shorts.

The Tour Spec Pleated Short takes a classic tailored shape and loosens it up for the course. A relaxed fit, front pleats and clean detailing make them easy to wear for 18 holes, then straight through whatever comes after.

THE FIT

  • Fixed waist front / Ultra elasticated Stretch back
  • Relaxed fit through the thigh
  • Front pleats
  • Sits on the knee

THE FABRIC

  • Polyester / Viscose / Elastane blend
  • Durable yet comfortable enough to walk 18
  • Tailored internal construction with tonal jacquard pocket bag lining

THE DETAILS

  • Premium Midiron embroidery
  • Side slash pockets + rear button welt pockets
  • Utility pocket on rear lower leg
  • YKK front fly zipper
  • Custom midiron trims

FIT & SIZING

True to size.
Josh is 5'5" and wearing a size S, Corey is 5'10, 75kg and wearing a size M.

If unsure of your size email us at contact@midiron.com.au and we will happily help.

title: Upcycled Vintage Titleist Cap
body_html:
when i was 10, my grandad gave me a hand me down titleist cap because i didn’t have one to wear when we played golf together. sure, it was nothing special to anyone else, but it meant everything to me.

i’ve spent the last little while hunting down these vintage titleist caps because i wanted to recreate that feeling of nostalgia for anyone who gets it. then we handed them over to @oxy.customs to give them the MIDIRON treatment.

three one off pieces that carry a bit of history, with a new story to tell. the giveaway winner gets first pick, and the other two will go drop on our site 48 hours after the giveaway ends.

TO ENTER:
01. follow @midiron_golf
02. like this post
03. tag 2 mates

entries close 5pm friday 17th july, winner announced on stories & contacted via dm. remaining 2 caps drop 5pm sunday 19th july, mailing list gets first crack 🤝

title: Tour Spec Cap
body_html:
Nothing to prove. Everything intentional.

The black cap is the one you reach for without thinking. It works because it doesn’t try. No camo, no contrast, no explanation needed. Just a clean silhouette, worn-in feel, and a fit that looks right whether you’re on the tee box or nowhere near one.

It’s made for the quiet parts of golf - early starts, empty fairways, late finishes. The moments that don’t need witnesses. The ones you do for yourself.

No hype. No signals. Just a cap that blends into your life and stays there.

On course. Off course. Same difference.

Details

  • 100% cotton twill with vintage wash
  • Plain black finish
  • Unstructured 5-panel fit
  • Adjustable strap back
  • Soft, lived-in hand feel
  • Wears in, not out
  • Golf Apparel Research approved

Warning: You’ll stop wearing your other caps.

title: "The Big Stick" Headcover
body_html:
Give your driver the cover it deserves.

This one’s for the club you trust the least and rely on the most.

Built to protect the big stick from carpark dings, bag chatter, and bad decisions off the tee. Padded where it matters, structured enough to hold its shape, and finished in a field camo that looks better the more miles it sees.

It slides on easy, stays put, and does its job without making a scene.
Like a good drive - you only notice it when it’s missing.

Throw it on. Swing away.
We’ll take care of the rest.

Details

  • Durable padded construction
  • Embroidered detailing with custom flag label
  • Camo print
  • Snug fit for modern drivers
  • Premium velvet lining to protect the crown
  • Golf Apparel Research approved

Warning: May increase confidence on holes you should probably lay up on.

title: Tour Spec Cap
body_html:
Seen by few. Worn by choice.

This cap blends in everywhere except where it matters.

Real tree camo, broken in feel, and a fit that works whether you’re walking 18, sneaking in 9, or grabbing a coffee pretending you didn’t just play a full round. It’s built for the long way in - garages, backyards, public fairways, and anywhere golf isn’t supposed to look like this.

No loud logos. No clubhouse energy. Just a cap that does its job quietly, until someone who knows notices.

Wear it to the course. Wear it off it.
Either way, it’s doing its job.

Details

  • 100% Cotton twill with vintage wash
  • Custom camo pattern
  • Unstructured, 5 panel fit
  • Adjustable strap back
  • Wears in, not out
  • Soft, lived-in feel
  • Golf Apparel Research approved

Warning: May attract unsolicited “where’d you get that?” questions.

title: Tour Spec Cap
body_html:
Low profile. High intention.

This one’s for the early tee times and the late finishes.

Field camo that looks like it’s already lived a few rounds. Sun-faded, broken-in, and comfortable in the places golf usually forgets about - public courses, back fairways, the long walk home when you stayed for “one more hole.”

It doesn’t shout. It doesn’t need to.
It just blends in until the right person clocks it.

Wear it when you play.
Wear it when you don’t.
Either way, it looks like you belong.

Details

  • 100% Cotton twill with vintage wash
  • Custom camo pattern
  • Unstructured, 5 panel fit
  • Adjustable strap back
  • Wears in, not out
  • Soft, lived-in feel
  • Golf Apparel Research approved

Warning: Hard to spot. Impossible to forget.
